main_text.p: itarum more tacitæ alicujus æquivocati-onis, aut mentalis refervationis, aut subtilis coactive & à verbis prorsus alieni interpretamenti adminiculo se quo[?] quo modo tueri utcunque posint; vel etiam postquam juraverint, rimam qu[?] elabantur, artificiosam aliquam evasionem reperire queant, velut [illegible, ~7 letters] μαχόν[?], quo juramento sic fraus fiat, ut salvis verbis sententia tamen sophismate aliquo eludatur, & vis ejus omnis pene enervetur. Non agnoverunt hanc Theologiam veteres Christiani: non hanc morum Philosophiam saniores Ethnici. Multo aliter ex illis Augustinus, § Per-juri sunt[?], qui servatis verbis, expectationem onem eorum quibus juratum est deceprunt. Aliter & ex his Cicero, {h}Quod Lib 3. de Offic.juratum est, ut mens deferentis concipi[?] fieri oportere, id servandum est.
main_text.head: SECT. IV.
main_text.p: Sed ne aut declamare videar, aut authoritate sola pugnare: confirmat aliquot rationibus, neutra simulatione tolli Perjurium. Ratio prima. Ex pe[?] multis illis Scripturæ locis, in quibus cordis simplicitas, cùm in omni cul[?]

page.notes: The right edge strip is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Greek in "velut ... μαχόν" is partly unreadable; the first word is marked illegible. "se quo quo modo" and "rimam qu... elabantur" are doubtful at the line breaks. "Ex pe" is cut off by the edge. The catchword "D" sits at the lower right, close to the page edge, so it is doubtful. The "§" before "Per-juri" is a printed mark. The hyphen in "expectationem" is not clearly visible; the word is given whole.
